= Passthrough substitutions
:name: Ada
:formatted: *attribute bold*
:replaceable: (C)
:url: https://example.com
:markup: <mark>inserted</mark>
:ncr: &#169;
:plus: +

== Structural forms

Single: +<tag> {name} *bold* (C) -> ... --+

Double: ++<tag> {name} *bold* (C) -> ... --++

Triple: +++#pagebreak() {name} *bold* (C)+++

Single numeric: +&#169;+

Double numeric: ++&#169;++

Triple numeric: +++&#169;+++

Escaped single plain: \+plain+

Escaped double plain: \++plain++

Escaped triple plain: \+++plain+++

Escaped single formatting: \+*bold*+

Escaped double formatting: \++*bold*++

Escaped triple formatting: \+++*bold*+++

Escaped single attribute: \+{name}+

Escaped double attribute: \++{name}++

Escaped triple attribute: \+++{name}+++

Escaped single markup: \+<mark>*bold*</mark>+

Escaped double markup: \++<mark>*bold*</mark>++

Escaped triple markup: \+++<mark>*bold*</mark>+++

Escaped single numeric: \+&#169;+

Escaped double numeric: \++&#169;++

Escaped triple numeric: \+++&#169;+++

[subs="-macros"]
Macros disabled escaped single: \+*bold*+

[subs="-macros"]
Macros disabled escaped double: \++*bold*++

[subs="-macros"]
Macros disabled escaped triple: \+++*bold*+++

Macro without substitutions: pass:[literal #pagebreak() {name} *bold* (C)]

Numeric reference without substitutions: pass:[&#169;]

== Individual substitutions

Special characters: pass:c[<tag> & &#169;]

Attributes: pass:a[{name} *bold*]

Quotes: pass:q[*bold* _italic_ #marked#]

Replacements: pass:r[(C) -> ... --]

Macros: pass:m[https://example.com]

Post replacements: pass:p[first +
second]

== Substitution groups

Normal: pass:n[<tag> {name} *bold* (C) https://example.com]

Normal quotes before attributes: pass:n[{formatted}]

Verbatim: pass:v[<tag> {name} *bold* (C) <1>]

== Ordered substitutions

Quotes then attributes: pass:q,a[{formatted}]

Attributes then quotes: pass:a,q[{formatted}]

Replacements then attributes: pass:r,a[{replaceable}]

Attributes then replacements: pass:a,r[{replaceable}]

Macros then attributes: pass:m,a[{url}]

Attributes then macros: pass:a,m[{url}]

Special chars then attributes markup: pass:c,a[{markup}]

Attributes then special chars markup: pass:a,c[{markup}]

Special chars then attributes numeric: pass:c,a[{ncr}]

Attributes then special chars numeric: pass:a,c[{ncr}]

Post then attributes: pass:p,a[first {plus}
second]

Attributes then post: pass:a,p[first {plus}
second]

== Escaping

No substitutions: pass:[\*literal*]

Quotes: pass:q[\*literal*]

Replacement escape: pass:r[\->]

Typst source stays text: pass:[literal #pagebreak() ) \ " #raw("injected")]
